title: "feat: "
---

## Problem

What specific workflow or retrieval limitation should this address?

## Proposed solution

Describe behavior, implementation constraints and expected user value.

## Evaluation / acceptance

How should the change be validated? For retrieval-quality changes, disclose dataset, labels and splits. The existing 24-query AI-assisted test is **not** a fresh independent held-out benchmark.

## Privacy / resources

Will this affect local storage, third-party media permissions, MPS/CPU memory, uploads or public network exposure?

## Out of scope

Multi-user/public production features need their own security design and must not be treated as part of v0.1.
